title: L-Ergothioneine Mushrooms Extract - Kingsci
abstract:
## **What is L-Ergothioneine Mushrooms Extract?**  
**L-Ergothioneine Mushrooms Extract** is a high-quality, naturally sourced ingredient that is extracted and purified from edible fungi (e.g., Pleurotus eryngii, Hericium erinaceus, or Agaricus bisporus), which are rich in it. The extract is a concentrated source of L-Ergothioneine, a sulfur-based amino acid with potent antioxidant and cytoprotective effects, ideally suited to incorporate into the development of high-potency nutritional, cosmetic, and functional ingredient products. To manufacturers, it presents a clean-label, plant-based option that can help to develop science-based products targeting cellular maintenance, oxidative stress, and metabolic vitality. The extract is usually in a fine, free-flowing powder, standardized to high purity levels, and is produced under controlled conditions of food- or pharma-grade. It is versatile with different dosage forms, such as capsules, sachets, emulsions, and gels, and thus it is an excellent chance to innovate in the functional wellness categories.
## **Working Principle**  
**L-Ergothioneine Powder** is a cell protector with a distinct mechanism of selective antioxidant activity and intracellular accumulation. It is also actively accumulated into cells (by a highly specific process) in preference to other general antioxidants, namely by the OCTN1 (organic cation transporter novel type 1) into tissues that may experience high oxidative stress, like the liver, kidneys, brain, and skin. In the cell, it serves as a stable thiol compound, scavenges reactive oxygen and nitrogen species, and preserves redox homeostasis without being simply oxidized. Its outstanding stability at physiological conditions enables it to support, over a long period, the integrity and metabolic resilience of mitochondria. Such a specific, non-disruptive mechanism of action offers it as an extremely valuable ingredient to be used in formulations targeting cellular health, stress-coping, and longevity-performance in nutritional, pharmaceutical as well and dermaceutical applications.
